# Task ADR-076-T3: a read-only file is refused, Windows attributes are kept

**Depends-on:** none
**Covers:** none — no spec
**Estimated scope:** S
**Owner:** unassigned
**Produces:** `readOnlyFor`, `keepAttributes`; the AGENTS.md and README lines
**Consumes:** `refuseFile`, `lineEditAt`, `stageFile`
**Data dependency:** hermetic
**Proof map:** v1
**Rests-on:** `a read-only file is refused for every op`, `an unlink judges the entry`, `the fix is named for the platform`, `Hidden and System survive a write`, `the docs say it`, `a contract row drives the binary`, `the packages vet for Windows`, `the other engine packages are unchanged`, `go.mod declares one requirement`

## Goal

A replace renamed a new file over a read-only one and an unlink removed it, both at exit 0; on
Windows a write stripped Hidden. M chose refusal on 2026-09-26.

## Affected Files

| File | Change | Why |
|------|--------|-----|
| `internal/apply/apply.go` | edit | `readOnlyFor` in validation; `keepAttributes` in `stageFile` |
| `internal/apply/attrs_windows.go`, `internal/apply/attrs_other.go` | new | Hidden and System carried on Windows |
| `internal/apply/paths076_test.go`, `cmd/mrw/attrs_windows_test.go` | new | the tests below |
| `AGENTS.md`, `README.md`, `docs/adr/BACKLOG.md` | edit | the rule, and the round's items closed |
| `scripts/contract.sh` | edit | §153 |

## Ordered Steps

1. [S1] Write the tests; confirm RED. [proof: mutation]
2. [S2] Implement; GREEN. [proof: mutation]
   Mutants: `readOnlyFor` returns ""; the unlink judged by Stat instead of Lstat; `keepAttributes` carries nothing on Windows.
3. [S3] Contract §153, the docs and BACKLOG. [proof: acceptance]

## Acceptance

```bash
set -o pipefail
go test ./internal/apply/ -count=1 -timeout 180s -run 'TestAWriteKeepsHiddenAndSystemAttributes|TestAReadOnlyFileIsRefusedOnWindows|TestAReadOnlyFileIsRefusedForEveryOpThatChangesIt|TestAnUnlinkOfALinkToAReadOnlyFileRemovesTheLink|TestFilePermissionsSurvive' -v 2>&1 | tee /tmp/adr076-T3.out \
  && missing=$(for t in TestAReadOnlyFileIsRefusedForEveryOpThatChangesIt TestAnUnlinkOfALinkToAReadOnlyFileRemovesTheLink TestFilePermissionsSurvive; do grep -qE "^--- PASS: $t \(" /tmp/adr076-T3.out || echo "$t"; done) \
  && [ -z "$missing" ] \
  && grep -q '^func TestAWriteKeepsHiddenAndSystemAttributes(' cmd/mrw/attrs_windows_test.go \
  && grep -q '^func TestAReadOnlyFileIsRefusedOnWindows(' cmd/mrw/attrs_windows_test.go \
  && grep -q '^# 153\. ' scripts/contract.sh \
  && GOOS=windows go vet ./internal/apply/ ./cmd/mrw/ \
  && grep -q 'A path means what it says' AGENTS.md \
  && grep -q 'A path means what it says' README.md \
  && git diff --quiet "$(git merge-base HEAD origin/main)" -- internal/plan internal/check internal/state internal/lines internal/iter internal/seen internal/subproc \
  && [ -z "$(git status --porcelain --untracked-files=all -- internal/plan internal/check internal/state internal/lines internal/iter internal/seen internal/subproc)" ] \
  && [ "$(grep -cE '^require|^[[:space:]]' go.mod)" = "1" ]
```

## Invariants

- A read-only file is never changed by a plan; the link to one may still be removed; a Windows write keeps Hidden and System.

## Risks

- `MoveFileEx` onto a System file; `TestAWriteKeepsHiddenAndSystemAttributes` exercises it on the Windows CI shard.

## Out of Scope

- Honouring ACLs or other permission models beyond the owner-write bit (permanent: boundary: the mark the owner set is the mode bit)

## Stop Condition

The fence exits 0, every Mutation Log row reads `killed`, and the Windows CI shard is green.
